title: Disc sighting on a Blue Ridge mountain
place_text: Blue Ridge Mountains near Boone, North Carolina

tellings.quote: And um I look up and that same craft, well, it looked the same. I can't say it was the same one uh that I saw on when I was a kid, when I was eight. Now I'm 18. Just turned 18. Appears in the afternoon sky, crystal clear October day.

plain: On a crystal clear October afternoon in 1973, on a mountain in the Blue Ridge near Boone, North Carolina, a disc-shaped craft appeared in the sky that looked just like one he had seen at age eight. That is what Steven Greer says, a man who argues that UFO secrets are held by a hidden global group. He tells it as his own sighting from when he had just turned 18, though he says he can't be sure it was the same craft.
